rationale: The agent correctly verified the user (name + zip matched a single account), identified the correct order, explicitly confirmed the exact return (air purifier from #W9502127, refund to PayPal), and then executed the return after confirmation. However, when asked about returning the vacuum cleaner, the agent stated an unsupported limitation (“only one return request per delivered order through this system”) and asserted the order status as “return requested” without tool evidence. This is fabricated/unsupported information per policy. Additionally, the agent assumed the refund to PayPal was the original payment method for that specific order without verifying its payment history. Due to providing incorrect/unsupported information, the conversation fails the pass bar despite the successful initial return.
